backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report describing two feature updates related to post‑quiz navigation, perfect‑score screen behavior, and the files they modify.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for multiple frontend files detailing styles, components, and quiz flow behaviors.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base setup defining extensive OKLCH color variables and theme tokens for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app via main.tsx into a root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Manages app screen state and routes between landing, quiz, perfect results, and Valentine flow based on quiz score.
frontend/src/components/audio/Background: Generates a soft oscillator‑based background tone and handles volume ducking when other audio plays.
frontend/src/components/controls/AudioTo: Button that toggles global audio on or off using Zustand store state.
frontend/src/components/controls/CopyLin: Button that copies the page URL and shows temporary confirmation feedback.
frontend/src/components/effects/Celebrat: Renders animated heart, sparkle, and confetti particles based on celebration type.
frontend/src/components/effects/Floating: Generates continuously rising animated hearts as a subtle background effect.
Defines global layout with floating hearts, background audio, audio toggle, and footer while wrapping screen content.
frontend/src/components/quiz/OptionButto: Styled answer option button with hover effects and selected‑state highlighting.
frontend/src/components/quiz/ProgressBar: Displays current quiz question number and a percent‑based progress bar.
frontend/src/components/screens/LandingS: Landing screen showing title, start button, Spotify embed, and copy-link button.
frontend/src/components/screens/QuizScre: Interactive quiz screen managing questions, answers, progress, sounds, and completion callback.
frontend/src/components/screens/ResultsP: Perfect-score results screen showing celebration, date coupon, redeem flow, and auto-continue behavior.
frontend/src/components/screens/ResultsT: Empty file placeholder for tease results screen.
frontend/src/components/screens/Valentin: Post-quiz Valentine prompt with yes/no logic, dynamic button sizing, final celebration, and restart options.
frontend/src/components/spotify/SpotifyE: Spotify embed that reacts to playback messages to duck or restore background music.
frontend/src/content/quizContent.ts: Defines quiz questions with IDs, text, options, and correct answers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAudioController.ts: Zustand-based audio store and controller for enabling audio and playing simple tone effects.
frontend/src/hooks/useCopyLink.ts: Hook for copying the current URL to clipboard with fallback and temporary copied state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including loading identities, login flow, and status tracking via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a placeholder hook returning no queries because all quiz data is hardcoded.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base/styles with a Valentine-themed color palette, animations, and utility classes for transitions and effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, shadows, and plugins, mapping CSS variables to theme colors including Valentine-specific palettes.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing the Valentine quiz app’s features, architecture, known issues, and requirements for the interactive flow.
